notes: Cycles are LLVM scheduling-model estimates: ReleaseAtCycles summed per resource across the write groups, as TableGen merges them, divided by NumUnits (rounded up), maximised over resources, as MCSchedModel::getReciprocalThroughput. Records of one mnemonic and form must resolve alike, or codegen fails. A mnemonic with plain and LDS records is keyed in each table. An LDS-only mnemonic is keyed in the plain table only. Latency is the LLVM WriteRes latency and is not used by the profile.
